Ability Games

Play online

The host picks 2, 3 or 4 players, creates a room and shares the code. Everyone else joins with it. You all play the same game at the same time and the highest score wins. Memory Match is turn based.

Pick the game. Wave Dash and Tap Rush use the settings from their menus.

Tap Rush

In Song mode the BPM is measured from your song and a tile layout is built on the beat. Slow songs get slow tiles and fast songs get fast ones. You have 5 lives: wrong taps and missed tiles cost one.

Wave Dash

The BPM is measured in your browser from the audio, and the layout turns on the beat. Slow songs make a slow level, fast songs make a fast one. Hold click, tap or Space to go up; release to go down.
